$comment: Q62 expiry monitor inventory. Read by scripts/expiry-check.mjs (daily, .github/workflows/expiry-monitor.yml) and proved exact two-way by src/test/expiryMonitor.test.ts: every secret/env NAME the repo references (workflow `secrets.X`, edge-function Deno.env.get/readEnv, .env.example keys) is in exactly one item's `env` or in `undated`, every *.louisianahelpr.com host the shipped code references has a `tls` item, and nothing here is unreferenced. read.method: tls | rdap | jwt-exp | x509-p12 | x509-pem | asc-api | vercel-token | meta-debug-token | supabase-auth-apple | no-expiry | manual. `manual` with date null is reported UNREADABLE every day until the owner records a date (or "never") with `recorded`.

items.sourceOfTruth: TLS handshake to www.louisianahelpr.com:443 (Vercel-issued, auto-renewed)

items.sourceOfTruth: TLS handshake to louisianahelpr.com:443 (Vercel-issued, auto-renewed)

items.sourceOfTruth: RDAP (IANA bootstrap -> .com registry) event 'expiration'. Registrar Squarespace Domains, AUTO-RENEW ON (owner, 2026-10-18), so it alarms only 7 days out: a registry expiry still that close means the renewal did not go through.

undated.STRIPE_IDENTITY_RESULTS_KEY: Stripe restricted key that reads ID check results (date of birth for the ID ban check, B49, stripe-idv-webhook); Stripe keys carry no expiry date unless one is set when rolled, rotated by hand in the Stripe dashboard
undated.OWNER_ALERT_PHONE: config (the owner's phone number for support texts), not a credential; no expiry date
undated.VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY: web push VAPID signing key (B65, an ES256 key we generate); no expiry date, rotated by hand (rotation unsubscribes every browser)
undated.VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY: web push VAPID public key (B65), the pair of VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY; no expiry date
undated.VAPID_SUBJECT: config (the mailto: contact sent with each VAPID token), not a credential
undated.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: Anthropic API key (Claude, the AI job builder and Declutter listing help); no expiry date
undated.PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID: PayPal REST app client id (PayPal phase 1); an identifier, no expiry date
undated.PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET: PayPal REST app secret (PayPal phase 1); PayPal secrets carry no expiry date, rotated by hand in the PayPal developer dashboard
undated.PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID: the PayPal webhook id the signature check verifies against (PayPal phase 1); an identifier, no expiry date
undated.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID: SMS alerts (2026-10-20): account id, not a credential; does not expire
undated.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN: SMS alerts (2026-10-20): Twilio auth token has no expiry date; rotated by the owner in the Twilio console (Admin > Settings > Text alerts > Check Twilio reads whether it still works)
undated.TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID: SMS alerts (2026-10-20): Messaging Service id, config, does not expire
undated.ASC_REVIEW_DEMO_PASSWORD: self-generated App Review demo password (Q1790 rotation script); no issuer, no expiry
undated.BACKUP_PASSPHRASE: self-generated passphrase; no issuer, no expiry
undated.CERTIFICIAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET: shared HMAC secret; no expiry at the vendor
undated.CHECKR_WEBHOOK_SECRET: shared HMAC secret; no expiry at the vendor
undated.FASTLANE_PASSWORD: Apple ID password; no expiry date (liveness is ios-beta itself)
undated.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: self-generated passphrase for a throwaway CI keychain
undated.PLAYWRIGHT_HELPER_SESSION: test session blob refreshed by the suites that use it
undated.PLAYWRIGHT_POSTER_SESSION: test session blob refreshed by the suites that use it
undated.PUBLISHABLE_KEY: Supabase sb_publishable_ key; not a JWT, no expiry date
undated.REFRESH_PR_TOKEN: optional PAT for refresh PRs (Q57); NOT set on 2026-09-23 (gh secret list), so github.token is used. A PAT expires: if one is added, move it to items with its expiry date
undated.RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET: shared HMAC secret; no expiry at the vendor
undated.SECRET_KEY: Supabase sb_secret_ key; not a JWT, no expiry date
undated.SEND_EMAIL_HOOK_SECRET: Supabase auth hook HMAC secret; no expiry
undated.SENTRY_ALERTS_TOKEN: owner-created Sentry token (Alerts read+write, Project read) for sentry-alert-rules.yml, Q185, 2026-10-21; not created yet. If Sentry shows an expiry on the token page when it is made, move it to items with that date
undated.SENTRY_READ_TOKEN: owner-created Sentry personal read token (org/project/event read) for the quota monitor, 2026-09-23; expiry not recorded at creation: if Sentry shows one on the token page, move it to items with that date
undated.SLACK_API_KEY: Slack bot token; expires only if token rotation is enabled on the app (it is not referenced as a refresh flow)
undated.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: incoming webhook URL; no expiry date
